discrepancies.reference_text: गुप्ता जी नाम है मेरा, आज आज का नहीं मिलेंगे।
discrepancies.translation_text: Gupta ji is not my name, you will not find me on Azadika.
discrepancies.explanation: The reference says 'My name is Gupta ji, we won't meet today' but the translation incorrectly negates the name and invents 'Azadika'.
The phrase 'Bring them' is completely missing from the translation.
